notes: Windows: a crew pointer shows only when its agent has something on screen to point at. An agent that runs a command, or works on a file that no window on screen shows, has no pointer. Nobody waits at the right side of the screen any more.

A place on screen is: the window on top that has the step's file in its title, a window the step names, or an exact screen point (an agent that clicks). The agent's own program window no longer counts.
The pointer flies in to that place, hops, stays 5 seconds and hides. The next step with a place brings it back.
An agent that needs you (a question, or "state": "waiting") is still shown and hops until you answer.
"done" is said only by a pointer that is on screen at that moment.

Changed for other tools: the short form Buddy.exe --crew "name: doing" has no place, so it shows nothing by itself. Send a JSON line with file, window or x/y. Your own AI (@name) is followed but has no pointer until it reports such a step.
Not checked: Claude Code and Codex with a live session (recorded samples only), and an agent that really clicks on the screen (a posted point was used).
